item.title: The Prusa CORE One+ Up Close: A 55 °C Heated Chamber and What Else Sets It Apart
item.description: The Prusa CORE One+ is an enclosed CoreXY workhorse with an actively heated 55 °C chamber. Here's what the chamber unlocks, what the '+' added, and the features that actually matter — plus the honest trade-offs.
